Name: Super Cellar
Author: N3rdGirl64
Description:
[size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/0PPnuQJ.png[/img]
This mod changes the cellar to a much larger version. How does it work? Who knows...BUT! It can hold 2192 casks!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RK7MTYt.png[/img]﻿
Make sure you have content patcher, then drop this mod into your mods folder!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/b6c2IjM.png[/img]
This mod will not work with any mod that changes the cellar.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/prY2LJu.png[/img]﻿
If you come across an issue please make a bug report and include your [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI Log
[/url]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3IoxJ6a.png[/img]﻿
I will not be making a version without the pillars, barrels, and forge...Please stop asking.

My [url=https://github.com/N3rdGirl64/Stardew-Mods]GitHub[/url]﻿[/size]
